quests.name: Short on Mithril Ore
quests.summary: The banker of Aldmere has run out of mithril ore.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 21 mithril ore and nobody in Aldmere has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Staff Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Aldmere to the staff shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the staff shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the archery shop keeper of Aldmere and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the archery shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Aldmere Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Aldmere Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Aldmere Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Snakes
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the snake near Aldmere thinned out.
intro: The snake beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 13 of them close to Aldmere and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Aldmere has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 16 bones and nobody in Aldmere has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Sword Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Aldmere to the sword shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the sword shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Realtor
quests.summary: Call on the realtor of Aldmere and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the realtor and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Supply Run to Brackenholt
quests.summary: Gather raw lobster for the banker, then carry a shipment to Brackenholt.
intro: I have an order from Brackenholt and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 raw lobster, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Aldmere.
From Aldmere? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Aldmere and bring back maple logs.
intro: The wilds around Aldmere need a firm hand. Start with 13 giant spider outside the walls, then 21 rat down in Aldmere Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 26 maple logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Aldmere for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the realtor, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the realtor.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Aldmere Sewers
quests.summary: Clear king scorpion out of Aldmere Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Aldmere Sewers is crawling with king scorpion, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Aldmere owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Aldmere Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 king scorpion fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Brackenholt (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather oak logs for the archery shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Brackenholt.
intro: I have an order from Brackenholt and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 21 oak logs, then take the packed shipment to the archery shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the archery shop keeper in Aldmere.
From Aldmere? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Magic Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Aldmere and bring back big bones.

When that is done, bring me 16 big bones to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.

quests.name: Sweeping the Aldmere Sewers (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear rat out of Aldmere Sewers and tell the fishing shop keeper.
intro: Aldmere Sewers is crawling with rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 21 of them, then let the fishing shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Aldmere owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Aldmere Sewers is clearer than it was. 21 rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: The Aldmere Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Aldmere and Brackenholt.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Brackenholt. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 31 snake near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Aldmere.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Brackenholt is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Aldmere has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Aldmere
quests.summary: Find what rules Aldmere Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Aldmere Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the banker what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Aldmere is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Aldmere Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Aldmere for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the armour shop keeper, fight your way through 31 bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 21 raw lobster back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Aldmere: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
